candidates.yourNature_desc: You feel everything in the vicinity as if it were weather, yours and everyone else's at once. Nothing announces itself and nothing has to. The saturation is constant, mostly invisible, and the sorting of whose feeling is whose never fully clocks out.

self_card.presence: Everything reaches you at full strength, all of it, all day. Feeling this much is weather work, and nobody hands out coats for it.
